required_fields.role_observed_present: zero or more defined supported roles; null when unassessed
required_fields.role_candidates: alternative unresolved role set; not observed role set
required_fields.mixed_roles_observed: boolean or null; true only observed simultaneity, not alternatives
required_fields.field_boundary_basis: specific preserved context/boundary/continuation observations, each with source pointer
required_fields.clipped_or_continuing_sides: registered directions or unknown; no inferred glyph completion
required_fields.full_block_grouping_notes: all subgroup alternatives retained, none selected as parent replacement
required_fields.candidate_object_ids_context_only: original list or null, not required to be singleton
required_fields.source_refs: file + SHA256 + JSON pointer + quoted operative observation + evidence extent
required_fields.conflicting_sources: all preserved claims with scope; no vote resolution
required_fields.shared_ink_or_overlap_dependency: other original IDs if known; no object/word independence assumed
